_description: PC Cleanup v2 tweak catalog. Each entry defines a data-driven tweak processed by the TweakEngine.

DisableAdvertisingID.name: Disable Advertising ID
DisableAdvertisingID.description: Prevents apps from using your advertising ID for targeted ads.
DisableAdvertisingID.detail: Windows assigns a unique advertising ID to each user for cross-app ad targeting. Disabling it stops personalized ads in Microsoft apps and UWP apps. This has no effect on browser ads. Microsoft documents this as a user-facing privacy setting in Settings > Privacy > General.

DisableDiagTrack.name: Disable Telemetry Service
DisableDiagTrack.description: Stops the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service (DiagTrack).
DisableDiagTrack.detail: The DiagTrack service collects and transmits diagnostic and usage data to Microsoft. Disabling it significantly reduces telemetry but may affect Xbox Live achievements, Game Pass connectivity, and Teredo tunneling. Safe to disable if you don't use Microsoft gaming services.

DisableCEIPTasks.name: Disable CEIP Scheduled Tasks
DisableCEIPTasks.description: Disables Customer Experience Improvement Program telemetry tasks.
DisableCEIPTasks.detail: Windows runs several scheduled tasks that collect usage data for the Customer Experience Improvement Program. These tasks run in the background and transmit data about hardware, software, and feature usage. Disabling them is safe and reduces background CPU and network usage.

DisableActivityHistory.name: Disable Activity History
DisableActivityHistory.description: Prevents Windows from collecting and sending your activity history to Microsoft.
DisableActivityHistory.detail: Windows Timeline and Activity History track which apps, files, and websites you use, and can sync this across devices via your Microsoft account. Disabling it stops local collection and cloud sync of activity data. This removes Timeline functionality in Task View but has no impact on other features.

DisableErrorReporting.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
DisableErrorReporting.description: Disables automatic error reporting to Microsoft when apps crash.
DisableErrorReporting.detail: Windows Error Reporting (WER) sends crash dumps and diagnostic data to Microsoft when applications fail. Disabling it stops the WerSvc service and prevents crash data from being transmitted. You will still see error dialogs locally, but no data is sent to Microsoft. This is safe to disable for personal use.
